title: SSUM Demands New Question Setters for Classes XI and XII Amid Paper Leak Concerns
summary: Student body urges COHSEM and Manipur government to prepare fresh question papers to prevent possible leaks
body:
Imphal: The Socialist Students’ Union of Manipur (SSUM) has urged the Council of Higher Secondary Education, Manipur (COHSEM) and the state government to appoint new question paper setters for Classes XI and XII amid concerns over possible question paper leaks.

SSUM president S. Yaima made the demand during a press conference held at the union’s office at Lalambung High School on Thursday.

Yaima called for the discontinuation of previously used question papers and urged the authorities to engage new question setters to prepare fresh papers for the examinations.

He said the move was necessary to address concerns over potential question paper leaks and help safeguard the integrity of the examination process.

The student body appealed to COHSEM and the state government to consider its demands and take appropriate measures to ensure the credibility and fairness of examinations for students in Classes XI and XII.

The concerns raised by SSUM relate to the possibility of question paper leaks; the available statement did not provide details of a confirmed leak.
